name: action_grounding_v1
purpose: Target the multi-step semantic bottleneck found in the complete frozen 128-episode capacity run. Exploratory paired diagnostic on every quality-eligible saved trajectory; no new rollout or training.
selection: ALL 8 quality-eligible successes, including every single-step case; not selected by prior distillation validity. Explicit development/replay set, not held out.
control: Archived original outputs, 5/8 valid and 0/3 multi-step valid. Do not regenerate control.
input_boundary: Both arms receive the same new action-grounded prompt and actual policy actions/success. Image arm additionally receives same saved initial/terminal RGB frames. No board, positions, derived offset, answer, solver trajectory, or verifier feedback supplied. Dynamics rule is explicit and checked against all saved transitions before inference.
verification: Unchanged directional schema/envelope allowance and reject-only exact action/condition/transition/route validator. Preserve raw output; no field correction, retry, admission or reuse in this diagnostic.
decision: Prefer image-preserving arm if it validates all 3 multi-step and all 5 single-step cases. Text-only can qualify only by the same gate if image arm fails. If neither passes, retain failure and diagnose without expanding this request set. Passing is development evidence only; fresh prospective validation required before further PPO.
stop: Exactly 16 new greedy requests, no model update, no checkpoint, no cold start, no changes to the completed capacity run. All repairs share first receipt deadline and completed requests must not be rerun.
